text.arabic_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ وَفَرِحُوا۟ بِٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِلَّا مَتَٰعٌۭ

words.gloss_range: the proper divine name as sentence-opening subject of provision governance
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name derivation includes worship-object and bewilderment pressures, while the local word functions as the proper name of the acting subject
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) opens the ayah as the named subject before the provision verbs arrive, so the verse begins from divine identity rather than from an economic event. The proper name makes expansion and measuring personal divine prerogative, while its worship-object and awe pressures sharpen why later rejoicing in worldly life is misdirected. Its stable pairing with provision and willing frames distribution as divine governance. The opening also forms an ayah-scale arc with the final {{ar:مَتَٰعٌۭ}} ({{tr:matāʿun}}): maximal giver at the start, diminished temporary utility at the close, with same-surah echoes sharpening that contrast (13:17; 13:34).

topics.headline: named divine agency first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah starts with the named divine subject before the action, making agency the frame for provision and valuation.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as the explicit subject of the opening provision verb.

topics.headline: proper name with derivational pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices more than generic agency: the proper divine name carries worship-object and awe pressure while remaining the local proper name.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is meaningful as background pressure, but local grammar selects the proper divine name as subject.

topics.headline: divine provision field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that provision and willing sit inside a familiar divine-governance field rather than random abundance.
topics.reason: The local clause directly contains the provision object and the willing phrase governed by the opening subject.

topics.headline: opening and closing frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah-scale movement from the maximal divine subject to the final reduced term for worldly life, with local echoes reinforcing the valuation (13:17; 13:34).
topics.reason: The first and final words form a structural contrast, and the cited same-surah links are concrete echo evidence.

words.gloss_range: ongoing divine expansion of provision, locally paired with measuring or constricting
words.root_gloss_range: spreading and extension branch selected for provision; simplification or explanation branches are not locally active

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: provision object governed by the expansion verb

words.prose: {{ar:يَبْسُطُ}} ({{tr:yabsuṭu}}) makes provision an ongoing divine operation, not a completed grant. Its concrete spreading image turns {{ar:ٱلرِّزْقَ}} ({{tr:al-rizqa}}) into an opened field, while the paired {{ar:وَيَقْدِرُ}} ({{tr:wa-yaqdiru}}) keeps the expansion calibrated rather than uncontrolled. The recurrent provision-expansion formula and the dense final stop before the provision object lands both serve the same local point: abundance is managed by divine action.

topics.headline: ongoing expansion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices expansion as a continuing divine action rather than a past settled distribution.
topics.reason: The verb is imperfect indicative and governs the provision object.

topics.headline: opened provision field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices provision pictured as a field spread open, while nonlocal Form II simplification senses are excluded.
topics.reason: The local object licenses spreading or extending provision, not explaining or simplifying something.

topics.headline: expansion with measure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that expansion and restriction are paired prerogatives under one divine subject, not competing forces.
topics.reason: The coordinated verbs share the opening subject and form a recurring provision-management binary.

topics.headline: formulaic and weighted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the local verb as part of a recurring provision formula whose sound carries weight before the object lands.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence rows and phonetic rows add local texture without changing the selected verb sense.

words.gloss_range: the definite provision domain as direct object of divine expansion
words.root_gloss_range: sustenance and allocation range, extending beyond food or money to the broader life-support field
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلرِّزْقَ}} ({{tr:al-rizqa}}) is definite and accusative, so the ayah names the whole provision field as the object acted upon by {{ar:يَبْسُطُ}} ({{tr:yabsuṭu}}). The word's range is broader than food or money: livelihood, capacity, opportunity, and sustaining allotment can all sit inside the governed field. Its position between the expansion verb and {{ar:لِمَن يَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:liman yashāʾu}}) makes provision the hinge between divine action and recipient allocation, with earlier same-surah spending reframed at the source (13:22).

topics.headline: whole provision as object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices provision as a known whole category governed by divine action, not as an independent supply.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, accusative, and the direct object of the expansion verb.

topics.headline: broad sustenance field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that provision includes the sustaining field of life, not only material income.
topics.reason: The lexical evidence supports a broad sustenance range while local syntax keeps it as the acted-upon object.

topics.headline: provision under divine agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices provision as sustained allocation under divine prerogative rather than autonomous resource flow.
topics.reason: The local subject and collocation evidence both attach the provision domain to divine agency.

topics.headline: between action and recipient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the noun placed as the hinge between divine expansion and whomever receives it, with prior provision-spending language brought back to source (13:22).
topics.reason: The local word order and same-surah echo both support this structural payoff.

words.gloss_range: recipient or beneficiary preposition in the phrase for whomever He wills
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) turns the provision action toward a recipient without making that recipient the cause of provision. Because it is visibly fused into {{ar:لِمَن}} ({{tr:liman}}), benefit, direction, and allocation arrive before the relative clause unfolds. The ayah thus names the provision field first, then opens the allocation tail under divine willing.

topics.headline: recipient relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition marks recipient allocation, not recipient agency.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the preposition govern the relative pronoun as beneficiary complement.

topics.headline: bound allocation tail
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices allocation built into the visible recipient phrase after the provision object.
topics.reason: The preposition is proclitic and begins the recipient phrase following the direct object.

words.gloss_range: open relative pronoun governed by the recipient preposition

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: open recipient phrase under divine willing

words.prose: {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) opens an unspecified recipient class inside {{ar:لِمَن يَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:liman yashāʾu}}). Its governed position keeps the whoever as recipient, not source, so the ayah blocks fixed entitlement while leaving identity determined only by divine willing. The abrupt later plural subject is supplied by the previous ayah, which keeps the critique attached to the group already described (13:25).

topics.headline: whoever receives
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an open recipient class whose identity is determined by divine willing rather than entitlement.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is governed by the preposition and forms the object in the relative clause.

topics.headline: prior group supplies they
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the later plural rejoicing is not anonymous; it continues the group from the prior boundary (13:25).
topics.reason: The boundary row gives a concrete referent link for the following third-plural subject.

words.gloss_range: ongoing divine willing in the relative clause, with subject recovered and object left open
words.root_gloss_range: willing and thingness field; local sense is willing, with thingness as conceptual pressure
words.prose: {{ar:يَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:yashāʾu}}) closes the recipient phrase by recovering the opening divine subject as the unstated subject while leaving the willed object open. That double compression lets the allocation include the recipient, amount, and act of expansion without spelling each out. The root-family link between willing and thingness adds the pressure of determination becoming existent reality, while the imperfect form matches the surrounding provision verbs: willing, expanding, and measuring belong to one ongoing governance complex, a thread that recurs in the surah (13:13; 13:27; 13:31; 13:39).

topics.headline: compressed willing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that both subject recovery and object omission make divine willing compact and broad.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence recovers the subject from the opening divine name and leaves the object unstated.

topics.headline: will with thingness pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices willing as the active local sense, with the root-family link to thingness adding conceptual pressure about determination becoming reality.
topics.reason: The local verb means He wills; the thingness relation remains root-family pressure rather than a second local sense.

topics.headline: one governance complex
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices willing, expanding, and measuring as coordinated ongoing governance, not separate episodes.
topics.reason: The imperfect aspect and surah-local recurrence support the governance-thread reading.

topics.headline: recipient phrase closes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the relative clause completes before the next coordinated divine action resumes.
topics.reason: The clause boundary separates the recipient phrase from the following coordinated verb.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction binding the measuring verb to the expansion verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first verb in the coordinated provision pair
second verb in the coordinated provision pair

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins {{ar:يَقْدِرُ}} ({{tr:yaqdiru}}) directly to {{ar:يَبْسُطُ}} ({{tr:yabsuṭu}}), keeping expansion and measuring under one subject. The attached surface form makes the pairing visible, and the conjunction gives coordination rather than a first-then sequence. It also helps the three imperfect verbs sound like one continuous divine-action cadence.

topics.headline: paired divine actions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices expansion and measuring as paired divine prerogatives, not sequential or rival actions.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the second verb with the first under the same subject.

topics.headline: attached cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the conjunction fused to the verb and contributing to the repeated imperfect cadence.
topics.reason: The surface proclitic and repeated verb onset both support the formal payoff.

words.gloss_range: ongoing measuring or constricting of provision, with capacity and decree pressure
words.root_gloss_range: measure, restriction, capacity, power, and decree field; local pairing selects calibrated restriction of provision
words.prose: {{ar:يَقْدِرُ}} ({{tr:yaqdiru}}) has no explicit object, but {{ar:ٱلرِّزْقَ}} ({{tr:al-rizqa}}) remains the recoverable field. Next to {{ar:يَبْسُطُ}} ({{tr:yabsuṭu}}), the verb selects measuring or constricting, while the root's capacity and power range keeps that restriction from sounding like weakness. The Form I wording and accepted vowel pressure expose the tension between measuring and capacity, and the compact stop texture counters the spread of expansion. Same-surah measurement echoes then converge with the final valuation: the ayah measures provision at the start and measures worldly life as temporary utility at the end (13:8; 13:17).

topics.headline: object recovered
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second verb remains tied to the same provision field even without repeating the object.
topics.reason: The coordinated verb lacks an explicit object, and prior direct object evidence supplies provision as the field.

topics.headline: restriction as power
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices constriction as calibrated power, not deprivation from lack of capacity.
topics.reason: The basṭ contrast selects restriction, while the q-d-r family preserves power and capacity as the means.

topics.headline: Form I pressure point
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the local Form I as open between measuring and capacity, with accepted vowel pressure exposing that semantic tension.
topics.reason: The variant pressure is useful contrast but does not replace the canonical local parse.

topics.headline: measure anticipates verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that provision measurement at the start prepares for the final measurement of worldly life (13:8; 13:17).
topics.reason: The same-surah and formulaic rows connect q-d-r measurement to the ayah's final valuation structure.

topics.headline: closed acoustic turn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a sound shift from spread to closure that fits the semantic move toward measure.
topics.reason: The phonetic row supplies local texture but does not determine the lexical sense by itself.

words.gloss_range: resumptive or circumstantial pivot into the human-response clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pivots from divine provision governance into the human response. As resumption, it opens a new beat; as circumstance, it lets the rejoicing happen while divine control has just been stated. Because it is fused to the completed plural verb, the transition into critique is carried by the same surface unit that reports the rejoicing.

topics.headline: human-response hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse turning from divine action to human response under critique.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks a new verbal statement after the divine-action clause.

topics.headline: while they rejoiced
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the rejoicing as possibly simultaneous with the stated divine control, making it miscalibrated.
topics.reason: The circumstantial reading survives as pressure alongside resumption, without displacing the new-beat function.

topics.headline: pivot fused to verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the connector attached directly to the plural perfect, making transition and response one visible unit.
topics.reason: The surface proclitic carries the discourse pivot into the verb.

words.gloss_range: completed third-plural rejoicing, locally blameworthy because attached to worldly life
words.root_gloss_range: joy and exultation range; local object and discourse make the joy misplaced rather than neutral delight
words.prose: {{ar:فَرِحُوا۟}} ({{tr:fariḥū}}) records a completed plural response after the ongoing divine verbs. The subject is supplied by morphology and by the prior boundary, so the ayah carries the earlier group into an inner misvaluation (13:25). Because the joy is attached to {{ar:ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا}} ({{tr:al-ḥayāti l-dunyā}}), the root's Quranic pattern becomes blameworthy exultation, and the following restriction clause immediately demolishes the object they celebrated; the same root later contrasts with rejoicing over revelation (13:36).

topics.headline: they from prior discourse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rejoicing belongs to the prior group rather than an unnamed generic they (13:25).
topics.reason: The plural suffix supplies the subject, and boundary evidence links it to the preceding discourse.

topics.headline: completed human response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices human joy recorded as a completed fact against ongoing divine governance.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect while the divine governance verbs are imperfect.

topics.headline: blameworthy object of joy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices joy becoming blameworthy because its object is the near-worldly life.
topics.reason: The bi-prepositional object supplies worldly life as the cause or content of joy, and contextual evidence supports the negative valence.

topics.headline: joy then deflation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the structure naming the joy-object and then immediately reducing it, with a same-root contrast elsewhere in the surah (13:36).
topics.reason: The final restriction clause follows the joy report and the same-surah row gives a concrete contrast.

words.gloss_range: preposition attaching rejoicing to its cause, object, or clinging point
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) governs the life phrase as the object or cause of rejoicing. The preposition keeps cause and adhesion together, so their joy is not merely about worldly life but fastened to it. Because the preposition comes before the full phrase is named, the attachment relation is heard before the ayah reveals the celebrated object.

topics.headline: cause and attachment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the preposition making worldly life both the cause of joy and the point of attachment.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the life noun as complement of the joy verb.

topics.headline: attachment before object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the attachment marker arriving before the object of joy is fully named.
topics.reason: The proclitic is bound to the noun that begins the object phrase.

words.gloss_range: first occurrence of life, definite and genitive as the object of rejoicing
words.root_gloss_range: life, living, revival, and given-life field; local phrase is worldly life as object of attachment
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ}} ({{tr:al-ḥayāti}}) first appears as a definite genitive object governed by {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}), so life is the thing clung to in joy before it becomes the subject of judgment. Its life-root pressure makes the object more than possessions: it is a whole mode of living, still a conferred living state rather than an autonomous possession. With the near/lower qualifier, the phrase is a stable life-nearness formula, and its later case shift lets grammar move the same celebrated life from attachment into evaluation.

topics.headline: life as attached object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices life first as the governed object of joy, not yet as the judging clause's subject.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the preposition and begins the object phrase of rejoicing.

topics.headline: mode of living
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the rejoiced-in object as a whole living state, with revival and given-life pressure kept under the local worldly-life phrase.
topics.reason: The root-family evidence is relevant, but local syntax and qualifier select the worldly-life phrase.

topics.headline: stable worldly-life pairing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices life and nearness as a stable existential formula rather than a loose noun-adjective pairing.
topics.reason: The adjective relation and co-occurrence evidence both support the fixed phrase payoff.

topics.headline: from object to judged subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the exact phrase repeated so grammar can transform what they enjoy into what the ayah judges.
topics.reason: The first and second life phrases repeat with changed case-role.

words.gloss_range: definite qualifier marking life as the near or lower life
words.root_gloss_range: nearness, proximity, and lowness range; local adjective qualifies life as proximate and inferior in contrast to the final reality

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: final-reality counterpart to the near life

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلدُّنْيَا}} ({{tr:al-dunyā}}) locks onto the first life noun as its definite qualifier, so the joy is not in life abstractly but in the near or lower life. The word's nearness is attractive precisely because it is proximate, yet the form already implies a farther counterpart, which the ayah names as {{ar:ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ}} ({{tr:al-ākhirati}}). Its return in the final clause keeps the near/final contrast active, and the rejoicing over nearness is ironic after the previous final-abode verdict and before the surah's later judgment scene (13:25; 13:34).

topics.headline: not life generically
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of joy is life specifically qualified as the near or lower life.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the word a definite agreeing qualifier of the life noun.

topics.headline: proximate lower layer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices worldly life as the proximate layer whose nearness tempts but also marks incompleteness.
topics.reason: The local adjective selects the near/lower branch, not a generic world noun detached from contrast.

topics.headline: near against final
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the near-life term already pulling toward its final-reality counterpart (13:34).
topics.reason: The local ayah explicitly contains the near/final contrast, and same-surah evidence repeats it.

topics.headline: near after final abode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices irony in rejoicing over nearness after the previous final-abode verdict (13:25; 13:34).
topics.reason: Boundary and same-surah rows supply concrete contrastive frames.

words.gloss_range: resumptive or parenthetical pivot into the corrective verdict
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the corrective verdict after the report of rejoicing. It can be heard as a new statement and as a parenthetical correction, so the final beat both follows and interrupts the human response. Because it is fused to {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}), the shift from report to evaluation happens as one compact move into negation.

topics.headline: hinge into judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah turning from human reaction to cosmic evaluation.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following material as a restricted nominal judgment.

topics.headline: inserted correction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final clause as both continuation and corrective interruption.
topics.reason: The parenthetical force survives as discourse pressure alongside the clear resumptive clause opening.

topics.headline: compact negating pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the connector visibly bound to the negation that launches the verdict.
topics.reason: The surface conjunction attaches directly to the negation particle.

words.gloss_range: negative particle opening the restriction resolved by the exception particle
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens a negation that waits for {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}), so the final clause is not a mere denial but a restriction. Every higher valuation of {{ar:ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا}} ({{tr:al-ḥayātu l-dunyā}}) is excluded until only {{ar:مَتَٰعٌۭ}} ({{tr:matāʿun}}) remains. The negative nominal structure makes the third beat a categorical verdict, while the surrounding final-reality frame gives the verdict its scale.

topics.headline: only verdict begins
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that negation waits for exception to restrict worldly life to one remaining valuation.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as the negation particle in the mā...illā construction.

topics.headline: categorical final beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final beat as a categorical judgment rather than another event in sequence.
topics.reason: The final clause is nominal and evaluative, following divine action and human joy as the third structural beat.

topics.headline: restriction inside final frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exclusivity of the verdict depends on both the restriction construction and the final-reality frame.
topics.reason: The row explicitly ties the mā...illā restriction to the following prepositional frame.

words.gloss_range: second occurrence of life, definite nominative subject of the restrictive verdict
words.root_gloss_range: life, living, and revival field; local role submits the same worldly living state to judgment
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥayātu}}) repeats the earlier life noun but changes its role: the genitive object of attachment becomes the nominative subject of the verdict. The same celebrated phrase re-enters under negation and exception, so the ayah does not swap in a synonym; it judges the exact object of joy. The previous final-abode boundary already gives the scale in which this life is made small (13:25).

topics.headline: same phrase judged
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same definite life phrase promoted from object of joy to subject of judgment.
topics.reason: The noun is nominative as the subject of the final nominal restriction.

topics.headline: living state evaluated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the lexical life pressure remains, but its new role submits that living state to valuation.
topics.reason: The word does not take a new unrelated sense; its same life meaning is recontextualized by syntax.

topics.headline: object re-enters for verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices critique enacted by repeating the exact celebrated phrase under restriction.
topics.reason: The repeated phrase and case shift form the local mechanism of critique.

topics.headline: previous abode frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the current final-reality comparison continuing the prior final-abode horizon (13:25).
topics.reason: The boundary row ties the previous verdict to this ayah's final-reality frame.

words.gloss_range: second occurrence of the near/lower qualifier in the verdict phrase
words.root_gloss_range: nearness and lowness range, now placed immediately before the final-reality comparator
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلدُّنْيَا}} ({{tr:al-dunyā}}) returns as the qualifier of the life now being judged. Its nominative agreement carries the same near/lower label from the joy clause into the verdict clause, and its position before {{ar:فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ}} ({{tr:fī l-ākhirati}}) sharpens proximity inside finality. The word also joins the final predicate pair: the near life is restricted to {{ar:مَتَٰعٌۭ}} ({{tr:matāʿun}}).

topics.headline: same qualifier judged
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same near/lower qualifier following the phrase into judgment.
topics.reason: The word agrees with the nominative life noun as its definite qualifier.

topics.headline: near measured by final
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices proximate life placed immediately inside the final-reality comparison.
topics.reason: The near/lower word stands directly before the final-reality prepositional frame.

topics.headline: near life reduced
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated dunyā closing the critique by pairing near life with temporary utility.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and repetition rows support the local verdict pair.

words.gloss_range: preposition making the hereafter the frame in which worldly life is measured
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) governs {{ar:ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ}} ({{tr:al-ākhirati}}) and makes final reality the frame in which worldly life is measured. Its force is not simple location alone: it keeps containment and comparison active together. Because the phrase comes before {{ar:إِلَّا مَتَٰعٌۭ}} ({{tr:illā matāʿun}}), the measuring frame is established before the diminished predicate lands.

topics.headline: within final reality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the hereafter as the larger frame within which worldly life is measured.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the ākhira noun and functions relationally in the final judgment.

topics.headline: subject and predicate frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the frame pressing on both the judged subject and the final predicate without forcing only one attachment.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence allows relation to the subject frame or predicate frame; the output preserves that pressure without overselecting.

topics.headline: frame before predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final-reality frame arriving before the only remaining valuation.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase precedes the exception particle and final predicate.

words.gloss_range: the definite final reality governed by the preposition as the measuring frame
words.root_gloss_range: afterness, lateness, finality, and active-coming pressure; local word is the hereafter as bounded final comparator
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ}} ({{tr:al-ākhirati}}) is genitive after {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}), making the final reality the environment in which worldly life is judged. Its root pressure is not merely later time; it is the coming-after, terminal comparator that makes the near life small. The definite active-participle shape presents that final reality as identifiable and arriving, and the stable worldly-life/final-reality contrast is reinforced by the later same-surah punishment frame (13:34).

topics.headline: bounded measuring environment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices final reality as a definite governed frame, not an indefinite future backdrop.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the preposition and frames the restricted predicate.

topics.headline: the arriving final one
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the hereafter as the coming final comparator, while the local noun remains the final reality frame.
topics.reason: The active-participle and root rows support arriving-after pressure without making the word a separate agent in syntax.

topics.headline: form encodes final sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the morphology preserving sequence: this is the reality that comes after.
topics.reason: The supplied morphology treats the noun as active-participle pattern.

topics.headline: near versus final axis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the familiar near/final contrast activated locally and extended by the later punishment frame (13:34).
topics.reason: The local phrase explicitly contrasts worldly life with ākhira, and same-surah rows add concrete continuation.

words.gloss_range: exception particle closing the negation into exclusive restriction

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negation particle paired with the exception
final predicate prepared by the exception

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) resolves the earlier {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}), turning negation into exclusive restriction. The particle both excludes other valuations and installs the final noun as the sole predicate. By delaying resolution until {{ar:مَتَٰعٌۭ}} ({{tr:matāʿun}}), it makes the last word land as the only permitted value of worldly life.

topics.headline: only remains
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the particle converting denial into a sole remaining valuation.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as the exception component of the mā...illā construction.

topics.headline: delayed final predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the exception particle preparing the ayah's last word to carry the verdict.
topics.reason: The exception particle immediately precedes the final predicate noun.

words.gloss_range: indefinite final predicate: temporary utility, goods, or enjoyment for use rather than an ultimate end
words.root_gloss_range: use, enjoyment, provision, and temporary goods range with durability-temporality tension; local predicate reduces worldly life to temporary utility

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opening divine subject contrasted with the final predicate

words.prose: {{ar:مَتَٰعٌۭ}} ({{tr:matāʿun}}) is the final predicate of the restriction, so worldly life is exclusively reduced to this last noun. Its indefiniteness and audible final tanwīn make the valuation unspecific: not the definitive good, but a kind of temporary use. The concrete goods-and-journey-supplies sense turns the celebrated life into something used and left behind, and the noun form objectifies enjoyment itself rather than leaving it as an action to pursue. It assigns the near side its value inside the final-reality frame, while the ayah-scale frame runs from {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) to this diminished close; the same formulaic verdict appears across other passages (3:14; 3:185; 9:38; 10:23; 40:39; 57:20), and the local object-smelting echo sharpens impermanence (13:17).

topics.headline: sole final valuation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the last word as the predicate to which worldly life is exclusively reduced.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the noun as the predicate of the restricted nominal judgment.

topics.headline: indefinite smallness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final valuation diminished by indefiniteness: worldly life is merely a kind of temporary utility.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite with tanwīn and functions as the final predicate.

topics.headline: goods for passage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices worldly life pictured as usable goods or supplies for passage, not a permanent end.
topics.reason: The local noun sense selects temporary utility and goods; durability pressure survives as a tension that sharpens deflation.

topics.headline: near life valued against final
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final noun mediating between near life and final reality by assigning the near side its value.
topics.reason: The noun sits after the worldly-life and final-reality contrast in the final restricted judgment.

topics.headline: recurring verdict formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices 13:26 joining a recurring formula that tags worldly life as temporary goods, with local echo from object-impermanence (3:185; 9:38; 13:17; 40:39; 57:20).
topics.reason: The inter-ayah and same-surah rows provide concrete references for the formulaic verdict.

topics.headline: maximal-to-minimal close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah shrinking from divine sovereignty at the opening to one indefinite temporary noun at the end.
topics.reason: The endpoint rows identify the ayah-scale opening-to-closing frame.

topics.headline: objectified audible close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices action-enjoyment turned into an objectified noun whose final sound makes indefiniteness audible.
topics.reason: The nominal form and tanwīn support objectification and audible indefiniteness.

baseline_models.mechanism: Provision is an allotted benefit whose usable amplitude is alternately spread and narrowed; expansion and constriction are two operations within one measured distribution, not presence versus absence of divine action.

activation_trace.role: The image of spreading against contraction supplies the expansive pole of one controlled range.
An assigned gift or share makes provision the distributed object rather than an ownerless quantity.
Will directed toward bringing about a thing supplies the selective agency governing the range.
Narrowing something to a small measure supplies the contracting pole paired with spreading.

changed_reading.before: God gives some people more wealth and others less.
changed_reading.after: God varies the spread and aperture of an assigned provision-field; both abundance and restriction are active modes of measurement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا فِي الْآخِرَةِ إِلَّا مَتَاعٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: Near life and later life establish nested horizons. What looks encompassing inside the near horizon is recategorized within the later one as a usable article for enjoyment and need: real benefit, but instrumental and proportionally small.

activation_trace.role: The nearer or first horizon supplies the observer's close field rather than an exhaustive world.
Posteriority supplies the larger horizon within which near life is rescaled.
Portable utility used to meet a need turns near life from destination into equipment.
Actual enjoyment and benefit keep the comparison from denying that near life has genuine use.

changed_reading.after: Near life is genuine but subordinate equipment: useful and enjoyable within its field, radically rescaled when located inside later life.

baseline_models.mechanism: The joy root can name simple opening of the chest or boastful excess. Here the attached object and immediate horizon-comparison make the diagnosis relational: delight becomes distorting when near life is allowed to set the whole scale.

activation_trace.role: Open-chested delight supplies the affect itself without making that affect intrinsically blameworthy.
Exultant self-satisfaction supplies the possible distortion produced by treating the near horizon as final.
Proximity makes the enjoyed object affectively dominant and explains how scale can be misread.

changed_reading.after: The verse tests what happiness is fastened to: ordinary delight can become boastful capture when the nearest life monopolizes perspective.

context_deltas.mechanism: Adjacent plots receive one water yet produce differentiated edible yield. This makes the focus distribution more than unequal access: a common input can be routed through distinct receivers into unequal surplus.

activation_trace.role: Amplitude and increase anchor the agricultural conversion model back in the focus act of expansion.
An irrigation share and its channel supply a routed common input to the mechanism.
Union in one direction makes the water a controlled common source rather than several inputs.
Increase or remainder supplies the differentiated surplus emerging from the same source.
Plant yield supplies the concrete output by which differentiated provision becomes visible.

structural_cues: 13:4 orders adjacent plots, one water, and then preference of some yield over other yield.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies common irrigation and unequal output; I map the receivers to the focus's selective recipients and treat conversion as the arrow. A live alternative is simple preference without any claim about receiver capacity.

changed_reading.before: Different provision means different quantities supplied at the source.
changed_reading.after: Provision can diverge after a common supply: routing and receiver-specific yield are part of how divine expansion and restriction appear.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hidden diminution and growth occur under exact measure, while communal condition changes through alteration within selves. Together they activate provision as a dynamic state with concealed increments and responsive transitions, not a frozen allotment.

activation_trace.role: Diminution supplies an unseen contracting process rather than a single completed shortage.
Growth supplies the paired hidden expansion within the same embodied process.
A quantity reaching its bounded amount places both hidden movements under measure.
Replacement of one condition by another supplies a reversible state transition.
The inward faculty supplies the site at which the context locates human-side alteration.

structural_cues: 13:8 pairs what wombs diminish and increase before universal measure; 13:11 repeats change on divine and human sides.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies biological decrease/increase and a separate social change construction; I join them as an analogy for dynamic provision. It remains possible that 13:11 concerns condition generally and does not specify material provision.

changed_reading.before: Each person's provision is a fixed amount assigned once.
changed_reading.after: Measured provision may be a changing trajectory whose growth, loss, and human-side transitions remain partly hidden while divine agency still frames the whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same spreading root moves from God's effective expansion of provision to a person's outstretched palms before water that never reaches the mouth. The contrast inserts a delivery gap between desire, apparent access, and actual receipt.

activation_trace.role: An extended hand for requesting or taking supplies a human-scale but ineffective counterpart to divine spreading.
The palm held out in request fixes the bodily posture of desired reception.
Water supplies visible sustenance that is near enough to address yet not actually received.
Arrival at a goal supplies the explicitly failed transfer from resource to mouth.
Effective extension anchors the failed hand-image back to the focus's divine provision act.

structural_cues: 13:14 compares unanswered invocation to palms extended toward water while negating the water's arrival at the mouth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated root, outstretched palms, water, and non-arrival; I infer a contrast of effective and ineffective transfer. The simile can alternatively remain limited to invocation rather than material receipt.

changed_reading.before: Expanded provision is simply a quantity lying within reach.
changed_reading.after: Provision is an effective arrival relation; wanting, gesturing toward, or standing near a resource does not itself make that resource received.

context_deltas.mechanism: Water runs through valleys according to their measure and carries swelling foam; the same foam appears while producing ornaments or utility. What rises most visibly leaves, while benefit remains. Expansion is therefore channel-shaped, and conspicuous surplus can be residue rather than provision's durable value.

activation_trace.role: Flood-flow supplies the moving resource whose spread must take a channel.
A valley as the flood's path supplies receiver shape and carrying capacity.
A bounded amount makes each channel's measure govern the flow it bears.
Floating froth supplies conspicuous excess that rides above rather than constituting the useful flow.
Increase and elevation explain why the least durable layer can look like the greatest expansion.
A useful article links the smelting image directly to the focus's classification of near life as utility.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the criterion that separates provision from mere visible volume.
Staying through time supplies persistence as the test of useful residue.

structural_cues: 13:17 repeats foam in both flood and smelting sequences, then opposes its departure to the staying of what benefits people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured channels, rising foam, manufactured utility, departure, and remaining benefit; I infer that these diagnose the focus's visible abundance. The live alternative is that the analogy concerns truth and falsehood only, without an economic extension.

changed_reading.before: The largest visible expansion is the clearest sign of abundant provision.
changed_reading.after: Provision is capacity-shaped flow, and its swollen visible layer may be foam; durable benefit, not apparent volume, reveals what the expansion carried.

context_deltas.mechanism: Provision is immediately shown leaving possession through expenditure and sitting inside a sequence of maintained bonds; the inverse sequence severs, cuts, and corrupts. Its realized value is thus circulatory and connective, not exhausted by stock held.

activation_trace.role: Maintaining connection and refusing estrangement supplies the social channel through which provision can function.
Money going out as expenditure supplies intentional outflow rather than retained stock.
The allotted gift is explicitly the source from which the outflow is made, tying circulation to focus provision.
Severing a bond supplies the inverse operation that breaks the connective route.
Departure from sound balance supplies the resulting network failure rather than mere low quantity.

structural_cues: 13:22 places expenditure from provision beside warding harm with good; د ر ء lacks a branch inventory and is used only as this sequence cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provision-funded expenditure, maintained bonds, severance, and corruption; I supply the flow-network relation among them. These ethical acts may expose provision's use without mechanically causing its material amount.

changed_reading.before: Provision is chiefly what a recipient possesses.
changed_reading.after: Provision becomes legible in passage: what leaves as expenditure, sustains bonds, and repairs harm can be more fully provision than a larger disconnected stock.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact will formula reappears with leading astray and guiding rather than with provision. Reuse across distinct predicates blocks a simple equation between expanded livelihood and moral favor: material amplitude and orientation are axes that can diverge.

activation_trace.role: The repeated willing of an outcome transfers the focus formula intact onto a non-economic axis.
Departure from guidance supplies one outcome that cannot be read directly from material expansion.
Gentle direction toward a way supplies the opposed orientation axis.
The focus occurrence anchors the repeated formula to selective material distribution.

structural_cues: 13:27 repeats مَن يَشَاءُ after a guidance predicate and follows guidance with the relative clause مَنْ أَنَابَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated formula with different predicates; I infer that the two result axes must not be collapsed. A live alternative is rhetorical continuity without a formal warning against prosperity-based moral ranking.

changed_reading.before: Expanded provision indicates that its recipient is better guided or favored.
changed_reading.after: Material spread is not a moral rank: the repeated will formula governs a distinct guidance axis, so abundance and orientation may cross rather than coincide.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later-life horizon contains flowing water, edible yield, and shade marked by continuity. The contrast with near-life utility is therefore not material pleasure versus immaterial value, but timed usefulness versus provision whose yield and shelter do not lapse.

activation_trace.role: Continuing gift and provision supplies an ongoing flow within the later horizon.
An edible share or sustenance supplies concrete provision rather than an abstract reward.
Continuance supplies the duration property that near-life utility lacks.
Protective shelter supplies a persistent environmental benefit alongside edible yield.
Enjoyment extended only for a term anchors the finite side of the duration contrast.

structural_cues: 13:35 places flowing rivers, enduring yield, and shade inside the explicitly named outcome horizon.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sensuous provision plus continuity in the later horizon; I infer that duration, not materiality itself, sharpens the focus contrast. The scene may also function independently as reward imagery.

changed_reading.before: Calling near life utility rejects bodily enjoyment in favor of a non-material afterlife.
changed_reading.after: The later horizon also has embodied provision; what distinguishes near-life utility is its expiring term, not its material or pleasurable character.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same joy root later describes recipients delighting in what was sent down. With affect held constant and its object changed, the focus criticism settles on orientation and object, not on joy as such.

activation_trace.role: Boastful delight supplies the focus's potentially distorted affective mode.
Simple gladness supplies a positive realization of the same root under a different object.

structural_cues: The joy predicate takes near life as its object in 13:26 but what was sent down in 13:36.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated affect with changed objects; I infer that object-orientation governs the evaluation. Different subjects and local rhetoric remain additional possible reasons for the contrast.

changed_reading.before: Joy is the moral failure named in the focus ayah.
changed_reading.after: Joy is morally mobile: it can become possessive exultation over the near horizon or receptive delight in disclosure, depending on what organizes it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Contraction receives a spatial process-image: land is diminished from its edges. The focus restriction can therefore be imagined as attrition at boundaries and access points while the center still appears intact, not only as one central reduction in quantity.

activation_trace.role: Reduction to a narrow measure anchors the spatial analogy in the focus's contraction verb.
Loss of part of a whole supplies incremental attrition rather than total disappearance.
The boundary or endpoint locates where contraction first becomes visible.

structural_cues: 13:41 orders approach to the land, its diminution, and the prepositional specification from its edges.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies edge-loss of land; I import that material process as an analogy for yaqdiru. Its immediate referent may be geographic or political, so the provision reading remains cross-domain rather than lexical identity.

changed_reading.before: Constriction is a uniform reduction of a person's total stock.
changed_reading.after: Constriction may arrive peripherally: shrinking reach, territory, channels, or options can reduce provision before the apparent center is depleted.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The debt-and-deposit branch is surprising and form-distant from the focus verb, but it remains anchored in the joy root and coheres with allotted provision plus eventual relinquishment. Render only as a lexical resonance: expanded goods may feel like delight while functioning as an entrusted burden, not as the direct sense of فَرِحُوا.

activation_trace.role: The root's debt-or-deposit burden supplies an inverted weight beneath apparent delight.
An apportioned gift supplies the entrusted object whose possession need not equal ownership.
Taking a thing away or becoming independent of it supplies eventual release from the held utility.

changed_reading.before: Expanded provision is uncomplicated gain enjoyed by its holder.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory resonance, the gain may also be a deposit-like load: pleasurable in hand, weighty in custody, and not finally retained.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-branch coupling is surprising because the focus uses basṭ materially, yet the same root inventory explicitly carries psychological ease and the ayah immediately names joy. Keep it as an affective echo, not a replacement translation: outward amplitude may dilate mood and help explain fixation.

activation_trace.role: Psychological ease and pleasure let material expansion echo as an inward dilation.
Open-chested gladness supplies the affective response that completes the feedback loop.
Nearness supplies the attentional bias by which the immediately expanded field dominates feeling.

changed_reading.before: The provision clause and joy clause report separate facts.
changed_reading.after: They may also form a feedback sequence: outward spread produces inward dilation, and the nearness of its object converts that dilation into horizon-capture.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The erasure-and-confirmation sequence is a remote contextual activation, not a license to settle doctrines of decree. It remains anchored through repeated will-language and the focus's measuring verb; qualify it as a possible distinction between mutable manifested allocations and a larger stable frame.

activation_trace.role: Will attached to bringing about an outcome anchors later erasure and confirmation to the focus's selective agency.
Deliberative measuring supplies an ordered frame within which manifested states could change.
Removal of a trace supplies the possibility that a presently visible allocation is not permanent.
The repeated will construction supplies the verbal bridge back to the focus formula.
Continuance and stability supply the opposed operation to erasure within one governed sequence.

changed_reading.before: Expansion or constriction is a visibly fixed assignment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the visible assignment may be mutable through erasure and confirmation while still belonging to a more comprehensive measured order.

strongest_changes: Measured provision became channel-shaped flow whose conspicuous expansion may be departing foam rather than durable benefit.
Provision became a connective outflow realized through expenditure and maintained bonds, not merely stock possessed.
Repeated joy and will formulas separated affect from its object and material amplitude from moral guidance.
Constriction acquired a peripheral process-image: loss can begin at edges, routes, and options before the center appears empty.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact oppositions repeatedly reopened under material context: one water yielded differently, stretched hands failed to receive, measured valleys sorted foam from benefit, finite utility contrasted with enduring embodied provision, and the same joy root changed valence with its object.
remaining_uncertainties: Receiver capacity is inferred from the plot and valley analogies; the packet does not state that it exhaustively explains selective provision.
The relation between human-side change and material provision remains analogical rather than explicit.
Debt-burden, affective basṭ, edge-loss, and mutable-record readings require downstream containment as lexical or cross-domain activations.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. `ب س ط/B001` is expansion; `ق د ر/B004` is narrowing provision. The paired verbs reactivate 13:8's decrease/increase. I infer calibrated range rather than arbitrary abundance; prosperity and restriction are two operations of one measure.
2. Rejoicing fixes on the expanded near-life, but `مَتَاع` is rescaled inside the hereafter. I infer a comparison error: temporary use is treated as the whole scale. The ayah changes valuation without denying present benefit.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 13:38's appointed term and book later clarified why present expansion remains a bounded allotment.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Provision changes width; exultation mistakes one width for the whole measure.** `ب س ط / B001` is spreading and extension opposite constriction, `ق د ر / B004` is narrowing to a scant measure, `ر ز ق / B001` is provision as an allotted gift, and `ف ر ح / B002` is exultant arrogance. The first clause oscillates between expansion and narrowing, while the second fixes delight on the presently near life. Nearby 13:22 turns received provision into expenditure, 13:25 contrasts good and bad dwellings, and 13:31 shows recurring impacts continuing until an appointed promise. I assign expansion/constriction the role of variable supply and arrogant joy the role of misreading a temporary state as final. The packet supplies fluctuation and later outcome; I infer present amplitude -/-> ultimate rank. The ayah critiques the inference drawn from abundance, not benefit itself.

2. **The near life is usable but nonterminal.** `د ن و / B001` is nearness, `ء خ ر / B001` is what is later than the first, and `م ت ع / B001` is benefit enjoyed and used. Their comparison places current life and later life on a temporal axis. I assign `متاع` the role of real but time-bounded utility. The packet supplies near, later, and use; I infer immediate usability -/-> final sufficiency. The line therefore does not erase worldly benefit; it relocates it as provision for a route whose return is developed in 13:27-30.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 13:27-30's dense return vocabulary made “near” life unmistakably a route-stage, not a destination. 13:31's recurring strikes “until” an unfailing appointment then corrected exultation by exposing a timeline wider than present provision.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Allotment and Expenditure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A measured share is given as food or benefit and then released in support of others.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: apportioned gift or share (`quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`); food entering and sustaining the body (`quranic:root_000560:B002/m01`); money going out in household or sacred expenditure (`quranic:root_001537:B002/m01`); beneficial action exceeding bare justice (`quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:22 `رَزَقْنَاهُم` (ر ز ق), `أَنْفَقُوا` (ن ف ق), and `الحَسَنَة` (ح س ن); 13:26 `الرِّزْق` (ر ز ق).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Allocation supplies both edible sustenance and spendable benefit; expenditure then moves that share outward as enacted good.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Expansion and Constriction
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The same resource is widened for one recipient and narrowed to a small measure for another.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: expansion, increase, and abundance (`quranic:root_000116:B003/m01`); constriction to a limited quantity (`quranic:root_001205:B004/m01`); apportioned share (`quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:26 `يَبْسُطُ` (ب س ط), `الرِّزْق` (ر ز ق), and `يَقْدِرُ` (ق د ر).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Opening and narrowing are opposed operations on one apportioned resource. The scene preserves agency and measure without turning abundance into an intrinsic status of the recipient.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Useful goods support a finite interval before the traveler or inhabitant returns to a final place.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: enjoyed benefit (`quranic:root_001395:B001/m01`); supplies and household goods used to meet a need (`quranic:root_001395:B003/m01`); prolonged enjoyment that remains bounded (`quranic:root_001395:B007/m01`); lower or nearer life (`quranic:root_000493:B002/m01`); later and final condition (`quranic:root_000019:B001/m01`); return to one's destination (`quranic:root_000065:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:26 `الدُّنْيَا` (د ن و), `الآخِرَة` (ء خ ر), and `مَتَاع` (م ت ع); 13:29 `مَآب` (ء و ب).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Worldly life is a usable stock whose duration can be extended but not made final. The latent travel-goods sense of `متاع` makes return, not possession, the scene's endpoint.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Eylem çekirdeğiyle ondan türeyen tapınılan varlık anlamının birlikte temsil edilmesi gereken genel açıklamalarda kullanılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, özel ad ile bu ada bağlı seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; herhangi bir tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel ad anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın özel ad, doğrudan seslenme biçimleri ve ant ya da şaşma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplara özgü işlevler özel adın her kullanımına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar özel adı Yaratıcıya özgü bir ad olarak tanımlar ve onu tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel adla köken bakımından ilişkilendirir. Aynı adın doğrudan seslenmede, yakarmada, ant bildiriminde ve parçaları düşürülmüş kalıplarda kullanıldığı birlikte gösterilir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Belirsiz bir kişiye yönelen kısaltılmış seslenme biçimlerini kapsar.
